title: Possibilities of Utilising Biomass Collected from Road Verges to Produce Biogas and Biodiesel
data_handling: Transcribed reported mean and standard deviation values. Censored n.d. sodium results retained as blank with below_detection status. Only the four exact biogas-yield means and SDs stated in Results 3.1 were included; plotted intermediate values were not digitized.
limitations: Whole-grass data from Poland are not GreenHub post-protein-recovery residual data.
Not a Dutch VARTA sample or universal seasonal feed profile.
Cumulative specific biogas yield is not methane yield; methane fraction is recorded separately.
Do not synthesize methane yield by multiplying evidence from separate or unpaired sources.
Sampling year and detailed anaerobic-test operating conditions were not added where unverified.
